org.aeonbits.owner
The goal of OWNER API is to minimize the code required to handle application configuration through Java properties files.

    Description
    interface 
    Accessible

    interface

    interface 
    Reloadable
    Allows a Config object to implement the reloading of the properties at runtime.
    interface
